'''Erisson Flask''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He fought [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] on [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]], and flew the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Silver Bolt]]'' with his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Polke]].
